subject: psychology
source_note: Topic structure follows the IB Diploma Psychology guide: the biological, cognitive and sociocultural approaches, research methodology, and the optional studies (Abnormal, Health, Developmental, Human relationships). SL students study one option; the four options are shown for reference. Topic names are guide-accurate; connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (the IB does not publish these).
